Pattern gallery, page 6 of 8 (15-minute bars, MES / MNQ / MYM)

Purple circle = the detected pattern; yellow = its bars; light blue = the 5 bars after; arrow = entry at the next open to the close 5 bars later. EMA 8 red, 20 orange, 50 blue; VWAP light blue; dots = 3-bar swing points, diamonds = 10-bar swing points (only those already confirmed when the pattern appears). Momentum(14) below.

inside bar breakout (bullish)

Rule: first close beyond the mother bar's high/low within 3 bars after an inside bar. 36,424 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

inside bar breakout (bearish)

Rule: first close beyond the mother bar's high/low within 3 bars after an inside bar. 32,236 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

nr7 breakout (bullish)

Rule: first close beyond an NR7 bar's high/low within 3 bars. 49,019 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

nr7 breakout (bearish)

Rule: first close beyond an NR7 bar's high/low within 3 bars. 44,368 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

clv extreme (bullish)

Rule: range >= 4 ticks; close in the bottom 20% of the range -> bullish, top 20% -> bearish (reversal). 193,345 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

clv extreme (bearish)

Rule: range >= 4 ticks; close in the bottom 20% of the range -> bullish, top 20% -> bearish (reversal). 218,622 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
